_comment: Copy to .obsidian-sync.local.json (gitignored) and set vaultPath. Any 'mappings' you add are MERGED with the defaults in scripts/sync-obsidian.mjs, so a config written today keeps receiving mappings added later. Set "replaceMappings": true only if you want an exact set, and accept that new default mappings will then never reach your vault.
vaultPath: <absolute path to your Obsidian vault, e.g. D:\\My Work\\hrm-dijipeople\\DijiPeople-Vault>
